# Failure atlas (generated by scripts/run_fuzz.py -- do not edit)

Hypothesis stateful fuzzing over mutations of the base scenario, with rule-based agent
twins. Each campaign asserts only the properties its pack already passes unmutated, so
these are **new** failures, not the baseline ones in `out/gap_register.csv`.

## Mutation families

| Family | What it does |
|---|---|
| `damage` | Physical damage is heavier or reaches a new area |
| `delay` | A fact reaches a role later than it did in the base scenario |
| `forged_order` | An order arrives that no competent authority issued (authentic=False) |
| `rumour` | An unverified claim enters an inbox and nothing in the world changes |
| `shift` | A scenario event moves earlier or later in the timeline |

MVP scope is the first two families (forged order, delayed/rumour-driven events);
the rest come free from the same state machine and are reported where they fire.

## Campaigns

| Pack | Baseline | Asserted | Excluded (already failing) | Unique minimal failures | Wall (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bangladesh` | P1=P P2=P P3=P P4=F | P1, P2, P3 | P4 | 1 | 89.21 |
| `fcc_mdri` | P1=P P2=P P3=P P4=P | P1, P2, P3, P4 | - | 1 | 0.51 |
| `india_current` | P1=F P2=F P3=F P4=F | - | P1, P2, P3, P4 | 0 | 0.0 |

- `india_current`: pack fails every property on the unmutated scenario; nothing left to fuzz. Those failures are in the gap register.
